_experiment.scientific_factor: R05 + exact categorical sequence-path authority only
_experiment.root_cause_hypothesis: The repeated late Test-AAR degradation may originate upstream of the modern backbone: the legacy epoch-dependent native-context curriculum changes the actual discrete state distribution independently of flow time t. R17 tests only whether making q_t the sole sequence-state authority and assigning CE only to sampled source/noisy branches improves free-generation sequence robustness on the untouched R05 parent.

module_contract.state: For each designed residue i, B_i~Bernoulli(t_g); S_ti=S1_i if B_i=1 else S0_i. There is no second epoch-dependent native-context Bernoulli.
module_contract.loss: Track the sampled branch explicitly; only M_i=1-B_i source/noisy events own sequence CE. Branch identity, not St==S1 equality, defines denoising authority.
module_contract.sampler: Unchanged R05 categorical refresh and U02 Cartesian sampler.

r05_invariants: PCS-RC source/context and recurrent proposal sequence context
FoldFlow fixed-g residue-level R3 support, g_scaled=0.1, coordinate scaling=0.1
U02 f01_r3_endpoint_canonical_hybrid target and f01_canonical_carrier sampler
three-round state-evolving AbFlow recurrence and dynamic R05 EGNN mechanics
global batch_size=56, max_epoch=200, EMA=0.999, BF16/TF32, Adam/exponential scheduler
Train->Validation->Test every epoch remains unchanged; no validation sample() rollout is introduced

formal_runtime.validation: existing EMA validation only; no sample() rollout

loss_hierarchy.new_scalar_weight: none; the change is support/authority, not loss-weight tuning

_experiment.decision_rule: Compare only against the same R05 parent. Do not combine this factor with another new module until its own causal effect is established.
